POSE 1: OK. Arms raised, balanced seated posture.
POSE 2: ISSUE. Left arm appears detached or floating; limb connection unclear.
POSE 3: OK. Seated straddle with arms overhead, stable base.
POSE 4: OK. Wide stance, arms out, balanced athletic pose.
POSE 5: ISSUE. Standing on one leg with knee bent awkwardly inward; poor balance/alignment.
POSE 6: OK. Crouched lunge or start position, spine extended, grounded.
